scope: expansion-0116 through expansion-0120, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Read all five final manuscripts and page scene notes before drawing. Viewed all 85 images in five 3-column contact sheets, then re-viewed all five revised sheets. Final detail revisions for 0116, 0117 and 0119 were enlarged and their entire updated sheets re-viewed. Full-size inspection: 0116 p12, 0117 p05, 0118 p16, 0119 p01, 0120 p12.
corrections: 0116: thick well cover, guardrails and fixed winch preserved; removed duplicate bucket in p02/p14; mist creature first appears in p08 narrative art and remains unnamed; walnut shell and stoppered bottle precede wide jar; fine cloth becomes coarse cloth with a release loop; raised fabric clears face and meets hand; cloud patch retained on final cushion.

0117: gray armor, amber eye and red scarf remain consistent; soaking pose has back in shallow basin with scarf beside it; removed duplicate tail, joined tail to failed spoon tool, moved wet vest onto separate stone; three old leg plates in p06; tail-tap pause respected; two old wing plates drop onto mat; new wings stay wrinkled initially then open; friend never rides new back; final flask appears once in a shell tray.

0118: first three snails become two after cloth answer; six dishes precede crowded wooden tray; holes stay on blank paper margins and preserve text strokes; sprite feet are supported on sill or table; empty return dish, relinquished questions, own window alcove and empty removed tray distinguish stages; final paper handoff uses a reachable table and one snail.

0119: removed duplicate girl; profile head contacts outside wooden door in change scenes; borrowed island landmarks appear only in the imagined island or picture book; blue door, curved-grain stool, bean jar and chipped shell spoon remain; removed guessed landmarks leave white mist and flat wooden floor; friend reaches spoon; two present-day cushions remain in ending.

0120: west-facing eye hollows appear only in west views and station east-window view; eastern observations have no eyes; rounded dune shading follows actual crest and no longer makes a sharp false peak; fish-shaped golden draft stays on paper; drawing hands meet tools; three color studies remain distinct; observation album has measured left page and matching colored right page; planning/future pages are blank, storm view is obscured, old drawings stored separately.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations. Review covers scene continuity, visible anatomy, relevant props, supported placement and overlaps. It does not certify hand-painted bitmap artwork, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
